correctness.rationale: At every fixed three-person effort profile 0<a,b,c<=1/2, independently signalled true state, weighted-majority fair ties and CPSR two-person headcount rule, enumeration of the four opponent signal states gives Delta(pi)=Ba(2pi-1)Q. With b>=c, d=b-c, either a+c<b (positive term) or a>=d, when F(a)=(a+b)(a+c)-(a+b+c)d is increasing and F(d)=bc>0. This proves Q>0 even at tie boundaries, and posterior sincere voting is uniquely optimal at non-tie pi; a joint strictly signal-following voting-stage equilibrium requires |mu-1/2|<min efforts. Independently evaluated 1029 exact-rational focal effort/payoff comparisons at a,b,c in {1/14,...,7/14}, confirming positive coefficient. This is not an effort-choice equilibrium and the grid does not prove the universal inequality.

The exact arbitrary three-way heterogeneous positive coefficient under genuine posterior signal-following is not obtained from either statement. A prior elementary game enumeration is possible, so originality is best of knowledge.
